pool.text: Pope Boniface VIII called for the first Christian Jubilee, bringing millions of pilgrims.
The Council of Constance settled the Western Schism and elected Pope Martin V.
The Landsknechts of Emperor Charles V sacked the city, ending the Renaissance golden age.
The Church began the Counter-Reformation starting with the Council of Trent.
Chef Bartolomeo Scappi acquired fame when his cookbook Opera dell'arte del cucinare published.
The Accademia Nazionale di Santa Cecilia was founded in the city.
Benito Mussolini did away with democracy and declared a new Italian Empire.
The Lateran Treaty created the Vatican state and affected territory boundaries.
The film studios were founded by Benito Mussolini before being bombed.
The San Lorenzo district suffered Allied bombing raids resulting in many casualties.
Rome was liberated on the fourth day of June.
The city hosted the signing of the Treaty of Rome establishing the community.
The city hosted the Summer Olympics in the twentieth century.
The city played host to the Eurovision Song Contest.
The city played host to the MTV Europe Music Awards.
Rome saw the opening of its newest arts foundation gallery.
The administrative areas called municipi were reduced in number to fifteen.
Rome became the principal town of the Metropolitan City.
Rome ranked as the fourteenth most visited city globally with tourists.
Globalization and World Cities Research Network classified Rome as a world city.
